roomRental.defaultRule: A dwelling is generally intended for one household.

conditions: owner is registered there in BRP

kamergewijzeVerhuur.permit: omgevingsvergunning generally required when multiple adults who are not one household share kitchen/toilet/shower
positiveCriteria: neighbour nuisance must be absent and demonstrated with the application
sufficient on-site space for bicycles/mopeds and waste containers

woningdelenFutureSignal.finding: Municipality announced investigation of a two-year friendswoning/woningdelen pilot for 2 or 3 one-person households; conditions were to be developed in first half 2026. Current rules at that publication date did not allow separate households simply to jointly rent one independent dwelling outside existing routes.
woningdelenFutureSignal.classification: policy-development-watch; not encoded as current permission until a formal 2026 decision/rule is positively found

woningsplitting.finding: Municipal parking information confirms splitting is an active municipal project category and states a newly created dwelling may be excluded from a resident parking permit where that was agreed as part of the split. A Gouda-specific general citywide splitting rule was not yet positively isolated in this deep dive; concrete spatial permissibility remains current-Omgevingsplan/address dependent. Area programs can contain more specific splitting policy, so those must not be generalized citywide.

application.login: DigiD for residents; eHerkenning for organisations
steps: upload documents required for the selected activity
submit concept request or definitive request
application.important: The Omgevingsloket determines the required documents per selected activity/location. Where Gouda does not publish a stable housing-specific attachment list, this dynamic result is recorded instead of inventing documents.
application.conceptRequest: available through Omgevingsloket; has no legal status and is not part of the statutory procedure
application.execution: ODMH performs building and housing supervision for Gouda and handles contact after building application submission

knownForRoomRental: evidence/argument showing neighbours will not experience nuisance
information on on-site bicycle/moped and waste-container space
dynamic: activity-specific drawings and attachments generated by Omgevingsloket
building/Bbl information if physical conversion is involved
additional spatial substantiation/studies for plan deviation where requested

fees2026.outsidePlan: base article 2.6 amount plus EUR 890.00 for small BOPA or plus EUR 6,389.76 for other BOPA
fees2026.extraDwellingContraryToPlan: EUR 10,252.00 surcharge/category amount as specified in article 2.6 for adding an extra dwelling contrary to the Omgevingsplan
fees2026.caution: Exact payable amount depends on the activity combination, building costs and selected Omgevingsloket branch; do not present one generic amount for all room-rental/splitting cases.

decisionTerm.rule: Do not invent a fixed Gouda housing-specific term where the municipal product does not state one; use the statutory procedure attached to the selected Omgevingswet activity and any extension/extended-procedure conditions.

remainingAllowedOnly: positive check whether the announced 2026 friendswoning pilot has since been formally adopted and become operational
concrete-address current Omgevingsplan/integrated-component result for woningsplitting and room rental
exact final document set and total fee generated by the selected activity/location
